items.quote:
The total number of family leaders over the fighting men was 2,600.
13  Under their command was an army of 307,500 men trained for war
items.contrast: The 2,600 family leaders as the men’s direct commanders versus Uzziah as the king whom the army supported.
items.reason: Uzziah is a plausible alternative because he is the king associated with the army, but “their” refers to the immediately preceding plural group, the 2,600 family leaders. Resolving that reference is necessary to identify who commanded the 307,500 men.
